data_description.appliance_name: Descriptive name for your appliance (e.g. Oven, Dishwasher)

data_description.energy_sensor: Energy sensor from the smart plug (kWh)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {appliance_name}
reconfigure.description: Modify the base settings for the appliance. Statistics will be preserved. Note: Energy price is now configured globally via the set_global_config service.

data_description.appliance_name: Descriptive name for your appliance (e.g. Oven, Dishwasher)
data_description.appliance_type: Type of appliance - thresholds will adapt automatically
data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor from the smart plug (W)
data_description.energy_sensor: Energy sensor from the smart plug (kWh)

abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfiguration successful! The integration has been reloaded with the new settings.

init.title: Appliance Settings
init.description: Configure all settings for your appliance. Default values are based on the appliance type.

data_description.start_threshold: Power draw above which the appliance is considered running.
data_description.stop_threshold: Power draw below which the appliance is considered idle.
data_description.start_delay_minutes: Time the power must be above start threshold to confirm the appliance is running.
data_description.stop_delay_minutes: Time the power must be below stop threshold to confirm the appliance has finished its cycle.
data_description.enable_alert_duration: Notify if a cycle runs longer than the specified duration.
data_description.alert_duration_hours: Maximum duration for a cycle before an alert is triggered.
data_description.enable_anomaly_detection: Enable AI-based anomaly detection for appliance cycles.
data_description.notification_services: Select notification services to use for alerts.
data_description.notification_types: Select the types of events that should trigger a notification.
data_description.unplugged_timeout_minutes: Time at 0W before considering the appliance unplugged.
data_description.custom_notify_service: Full service name for custom notifications (e.g., notify.my_service).
data_description.enable_auto_shutdown: Automatically turn off the appliance's switch after a cycle finishes.
data_description.auto_shutdown_delay_minutes: Delay after cycle completion before turning off the switch.
data_description.auto_shutdown_entity: The switch entity controlling the appliance's power.
data_description.enable_energy_limits: Set energy consumption limits to receive alerts.
data_description.energy_limit_cycle: Maximum energy consumption per cycle (in kWh).
data_description.cost_budget_monthly: Monthly cost budget for this appliance (in your currency).
data_description.enable_scheduling: Restrict appliance usage to specific times.
data_description.allowed_hours_start: Start of the time window when usage is allowed.
data_description.allowed_hours_end: End of the time window when usage is allowed.
data_description.blocked_days: Select days of the week when usage is not allowed.
data_description.scheduling_mode: Mode for handling usage outside allowed hours (notify or block).
data_description.show_status: Toggle visibility of the Status card in the dashboard.
data_description.show_statistics_basic: Toggle visibility of the Basic Statistics card.
data_description.show_statistics_advanced: Toggle visibility of the Advanced Statistics card.
data_description.show_current_cycle: Toggle visibility of the Current Cycle card.
data_description.show_power_graph: Toggle visibility of the Power Graph card.
data_description.show_controls: Toggle visibility of the Controls card.
data_description.show_ai_actions: Toggle visibility of the AI Actions card.
data_description.show_services: Toggle visibility of the Services card.

create_dashboard.name: Create Dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Creates a unified multi-tab dashboard with an overview view and one view per configured appliance.

force_recreate.name: Force Recreate
force_recreate.description: If true, deletes and recreates the dashboard from scratch.

update_dashboard.name: Update Dashboard
update_dashboard.description: Updates the existing dashboard by adding views for new appliances and removing views for deleted appliances.

configure_dashboard.name: Configure Dashboard
configure_dashboard.description: Applies personalization settings to the dashboard (colors, visible sections, custom names).

global_settings.name: Global Settings
global_settings.description: Global dashboard settings (custom cards, theme, colors, auto-update)

overview_sections.name: Overview Sections
overview_sections.description: List of sections to show in the overview view

appliance_views.name: Appliance Views Configuration
appliance_views.description: Per-appliance view configuration (enabled, template, color, sections visibility)

toggle_view.name: Toggle View
toggle_view.description: Enables or disables a specific appliance view in the dashboard.

appliance_id.name: Appliance ID
appliance_id.description: ID of the appliance (e.g., lave_linge, lave_vaisselle)
